title: [2.7] App stops suddenly without error
symptom: AAPS 2.7.0 app stops suddenly for some hours during night. Display opens but without glucose values during stop, algorithm stops, only basal running, dark blue color on insulin curve. After a while app proceeds as normal, no error message at all. Some users report the app stops at the same time daily, and when restarted it re-initializes as if the phone was rebooted.
cause: The thread does not establish a single root cause. Possible causes mentioned include battery optimization, Google Play Protect, and issues from upgrading from 2.6 to 2.7.
fix: Several workarounds were reported: disabling energy optimization (S10), clearing cache and clean reinstall, deactivating Google Play Protect, and disabling automated optimization under device care. The thread does not state an official fix.
settings_changed: automated optimization under device care → off
evidence_quote: I have put off the automated optimization under device care and this worked for me.
